senses.gloss: m. (φασιανός, sub. ὀῤνις) [bird from the river Phasis in Colchis,] pheasant (Phasianus Colchicus).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>מי שהיה מתאוה תרנגול או פסיון וכ׳</he> whoever desired to eat chicken or pheasant, found the taste of it in the manna.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:8">Tosef. Kil. I, 8</cite> <he>תרנגול … ופ׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="Q01225"><he>פסאני</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01273"><he>פַּסְיָאנִי</he></cite>) chicken, peacock and pheasant, although resembling one another, are heterogeneous birds; Y. ib. I, 27ᵃ bot. <he>הפוסיוני</he>; Y. B. Kam. V, end, 5ᵃ <he>פי׳</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Yoma 75b:7">Yoma 75ᵇ</cite> (as a species of quail, v. <cite ref="O00979"><he>סְלָיו</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:16">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01281"><he>פִּסְיוֹנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01281"><he>פִּסְיוֹנִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:16">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ וראשי פטומות</he> pheasants and choice of fattened birds; a. e.
